correctness.rationale: For a compact invariant measure, testing the generator against arbitrary antiderivatives of \(z\) and \(w\) gives the two conditional identities exactly. The \(w\)-identity and bounded \(x\) force \(|w|\) away from zero before any reciprocal is used. Conditional variance then gives the two nonnegative squared-speed defects. Vanishing of either defect plus support invariance freezes \(z\) or \(w\) and propagates through the ODE to an equilibrium. The future-memory formula follows by integrating \(d(e^{-dt}z)/dt=c e^{-dt}w\) to positive infinity on a bounded complete trajectory. The packaged exact checker verifies the standard-parameter coefficients and equilibrium substitutions.

value.rationale: The extra linear coordinate is the structural ingredient Rössler added to move from chaos to hyperchaos. On every bounded recurrent state, its positive linear coefficient forces an exact future-memory representation rather than an arbitrary additional degree of freedom. Simultaneously, stationarity makes the reinjection coordinate an exact conditional projection of that memory coordinate and yields an equality-rigid variance budget. The multiplicative reinjection equation provides a second reciprocal-coordinate projection and speed budget. These are parameter-explicit, all-invariant-measure diagnostics for the benchmark first hyperchaotic flow and apply to both chaotic and hyperchaotic compact invariant sets without requiring numerical estimation of an invariant density.
